question.knowledge_point: Determining the Image of an Object Formed by a Singular Transformation
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14060375/assets/d88ae8667df81624f0a28295c980f846ae88e9b4766fe0d0f692dd75509a56e9.png)

Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 8 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Which of the following is the image of the triangle shown above under the action of $T?$
question.worked_solution:
To find the image of the triangle under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of the triangle:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 8 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & 2 \\ 4 & 20 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the image's vertices are $(1,4)$, $(5,20)$, and  $(2,8).$  Notice that all three points lie on the same line.
